body:
## What it does

Org mapping rather than a candidate search: it builds the picture of a company's people, which does mean assembling public professional data about individuals who have not asked to be mapped. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @NickRoman shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
